name: Daily Payment Summary status counters reconcile with All
description:
1. Sign in, open Daily Payment Summary and filter it to the latest day with payments.
2. Read the All, Processing, Skipped, Declined, Paused, and Approved tab counts.
3. Confirm each tab shows its server count.
4. Confirm All equals the tab statuses plus the statuses that have no tab (Scheduled, Payment Declined - Cleared, Payment Declined - Partially Cleared).
